req.title: Login required for update
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they attempt GET /<id>/update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to access the update endpoint. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can update posts, maintaining security and data integrity. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this requirement.

tests.name: test_login_required_for_update_positive
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/1/update')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_login_required_for_update_negative
preconditions: User is logged in as a non-author
expected: 403 Forbidden if user is not the author
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})
response = client.get('/1/update')
assert response.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_login_required_for_update_boundary
actions: Attempt to access GET /<id>/update with id=0
